key_format: layer/<URL-escaped layer name>~<layer name occurrence>/effect/<URL-escaped native effect name>~<native name occurrence>
notes: Only explicitly saved numeric, boolean and choice values are mapped to current controls. Missing controls remain unknown; serialized XML default is recorded only where explicitly present.
Exact original decimal strings are authoritative; numeric value is convenience conversion.
Native timeline phases are historical snapshots, not inferred static home values. Animation flags and phase data are preserved raw.
Wrapper Opacity and ChoosableMixer Opacity are distinct and are not conflated.
